pct.$comment: The primitive tier, cut down to the one scale point 10 asks about. The gate resolves a token by following `{…}` aliases, so the floor has to be declared SOMEWHERE for any of them to reach it — which is exactly what the `touch-floor-token-gone` case takes away.

target.$comment: Minimum touch area per WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (24x24 px).
